title: qxmd178 · Marks mobile: stem never above header when Solution open
body: Root cause: absolute top:0/-9999 stem-hide + #app-main scrolling whole shell let orphan/host stem paint above blue .eg-top. Fix: static display:none stem-hide; fixed fullscreen practice chrome with overflow only on .eg-body; hide host .q-card strips; eg-qxmd178 defensive CSS/JS; Show Answer sync kept; Clear hidden mobile; Prev/Next visible; soft lim glued-prose unglue; Quantrex; no Vercel.
